subject: Logic
title: Complementary Probability
description: A quick win: understand Complementary Probability.

hook.text: What's the chance of NOT rolling a six? Sometimes it's easier to calculate what won't happen.

buildup.text: The complement of an event covers everything that isn't the event. Subtract its probability from one.

discovery.text: Probability of rolling a six: 1/6. Probability of not rolling a six: 1 - 1/6 = 5/6. Much simpler.

twist.text: Complex problems often become trivial when you calculate the complement instead of the event directly.

climax.text: "At least one" problems are prime candidates. Calculate "none" and subtract from 1.

punchline.text: Flip the question, simplify the math.

quiz.question: If P(A) = 0.3, what is P(not A)?
